SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC-20 token failed.

associateQuoteToken().notice: The contract holds the quote token for a moment during `buy`, so it must be associated. Idempotent and only ever associates the configured quote token, so anyone may call it.

bandBps().notice: Largest premium over NAV a buyer pays, in basis points.

maxNavAge().notice: NAV older than this (seconds) is refused.

previewBuy(uint256).notice: What `quoteIn` buys right now and how far the effective price sits from NAV (positive = premium, negative = discount), in basis points.

userdoc.notice: Buys RWA units on a DEX only when the price paid stays within `bandBps` above the appraised NAV. Thin RWA pools are easy to move, so the NAV oracle is the reference and the pool only executes. The quote token is assumed to be a USD stablecoin (testnet USDC 0.0.5449). The buyer receives the units directly from the pool, so it must be associated and KYC'd.
